text: Context-length trap: Ollama's server default context depends on VRAM (under 24 GiB: 4k; 24-48 GiB: 32k; 48 GiB or more: 256k) and its docs recommend at least 64000 tokens for agents, web search and coding tools. Set num_ctx in ChatOllama or context_window/additional_kwargs in LlamaIndex, or OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH on the server, and check with ollama ps. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)
